product_overview: Dynamic CMS Template is a headless CMS that lets authenticated administrators design database tables, manage columns, and work with table data through a visual admin interface. It supports schema creation and editing, media fields, and authenticated data viewing with uploads and reusable assets.
core_goals: Sign in to the admin interface and access authorized workspace features
Create new database tables with selectable column types, including media types
Edit existing table schemas by adding or removing columns or deleting tables
View table records and manage media values with uploads or reusable assets
Open the schema editor from the tables list for faster table management

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can sign in to access the authenticated admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter username -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See authenticated admin area

features.name: Schema editor for existing table
features.description: Users can inspect and modify an existing table schema, including adding columns, removing columns, and deleting the table.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/tables -> Open the schema editor for a table -> See the existing columns and type labels -> Enter a new column name -> Choose a column type -> Optionally enable unique constraint -> Add the column -> See the updated schema
Navigate to /admin/tables -> Open the schema editor for a table -> Select a non-system column -> Remove the column -> See the schema update
Navigate to /admin/tables -> Open the schema editor for a table -> Enter the exact table name -> Confirm table deletion -> See the table removed from the schema list
Navigate to /admin/tables -> Open the schema editor for a table -> Enter a new column name -> Pick a media type -> Add the column -> See the new media column in the schema
Navigate to /admin/tables -> Open the schema editor for a table -> Try to remove a guarded column -> See an inline validation message

features.name: Create-table wizard with media column types
features.description: Users can create a new table and include standard or media column types while reviewing the generated SQL preview.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/tables/create -> Add a column -> Open the type selector -> Choose a media type -> See the SQL preview update -> Create the table -> See the new table appear in the tables list
Navigate to /admin/tables/create -> Add multiple columns -> Choose different column types for each column -> Review the SQL preview -> Create the table -> See the table available for management

features.name: Media upload and library picker in data viewer
features.description: Users can store media values in table cells by uploading a file or selecting an existing workspace asset, then preview or clear the stored media.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/data/[table] -> Open a media cell -> Open the media picker -> Upload a file -> See the media value saved in the cell -> See a thumbnail or file indicator preview

Navigate to /admin/data/[table] -> Open a media cell -> Open the media picker -> Search the library by file name -> Select an asset -> See the chosen asset stored in the cell -> See the preview update
Navigate to /admin/data/[table] -> Open a media cell -> Open the media picker -> Clear the current media value -> See the cell become empty

features.name: Schema entry point from tables list
features.description: Users can start schema management directly from the tables list for any listed table.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/tables -> Click Schema on a table row -> Land on the schema editor for that table -> View and manage the table schema

routes.description: Login page; dev fallback authenticates username/password against the backend
Tables list; each row exposes a Schema entry point to the schema editor
Create-table wizard; type picker now includes image/file/attachment media types
Schema editor for an existing table (add column, drop column, delete table)
DataViewer; media columns get an upload widget, library picker and thumbnail/preview

features.name: Schema editor for existing table
features.description: Add a column (including media types), drop a column, or delete the table, wired to the F0 backend endpoints with server-enforced guards
user_interactions: Open the schema editor from the Schema button on a table row
See the list of existing columns with type labels and PK/UNIQ/FK badges
Enter a new column name and pick a type from the dropdown
Pick a media type (imagem, arquivo, anexo) for the new column
Toggle the Único switch and click Adicionar coluna
Click the trash icon on a non-system column to drop it
Type the exact table name in the danger zone and click Excluir tabela
See an inline error when a guard rejects (relation in use, drop on SQLite)

features.name: Media column type in create wizard
features.description: The create-table wizard offers image/file/attachment column types from a shared type source, sending the canonical lowercase data_type to the backend
user_interactions: Add a column in the wizard
Open the type dropdown and select imagem, arquivo or anexo
See the generated SQL preview update
Click Criar tabela to submit

features.name: Media upload and library picker in DataViewer
features.description: Media cells render an upload widget plus a workspace library picker in a modal; the selected/uploaded file URL is stored in the cell and previewed
user_interactions: Click the Arquivo button in an empty media cell to open the media modal
Drag a file onto the dropzone or click to choose a file to upload
Browse the workspace library grid and click an asset to reuse it
Search the library by file name
See an image thumbnail or a file icon with a download link in the cell
Click the remove (x) control to clear a media value

features.name: Schema entry point on tables list
features.description: Each table row (magazine and grid layouts) gets a Schema action that navigates to the schema editor
user_interactions: Click the Schema button on a table row
Land on the schema editor for that table

known_limitations.issue: Media preview/thumbnail depends on the backend media serving URL being reachable (dev filesystem serving route); public-site media rendering is out of scope (F3)
known_limitations.impact: Thumbnails only render inside the authenticated admin DataViewer in F2

known_limitations.issue: Drop-column is Postgres-only; on SQLite dev it returns a controlled 400 error surfaced inline
known_limitations.impact: In local SQLite dev, dropping a column shows an error message instead of removing it

known_limitations.issue: Master role is 403 on schema mutation and asset endpoints; the UI hides those controls for master
known_limitations.impact: Master sees a read-only schema editor and preview-only media cells
